Results.ReviewText:
Wow, what a fantastic 5-year warranty I have on my barbecue... said no one ever. The sticker on the grill says 5 years, but surprise! The gas regulator, which apparently is the part that decides whether my grill works or not, only has a 2-year warranty hidden in the fine print.

When I called for support, the agent kindly offered to sell me a new regulator for $80. Because, you know, I'm made of money. But hey, being the thrifty customer I am, I did some research and found the exact same regulator on Amazon for $30. Score!

So, I asked for a price match, and the agent graciously gave me a 20% discount. I mean, who doesn't love saving $10? But the cherry on top was when she warned me against buying "substandard" regulators from Amazon... the same product that has a 4.8-star rating and has been purchased by over a thousand happy customers.

I think it's safe to say who's selling the substandard product here. Weber, you might want to work on your warranty game and customer service skills. 1 star from me, that's being generous. Sorry, 1.2 stars with 20% extra to make it fair and square.
Cheers!
